turns.agent: Witness! Venerate your Disciple! Heh heh. [exhales] Let the war beasts feast tonight!

turns.user: You speak as if the end were a banquet.
turns.agent: You were bred to be a sorrow-bearer. I seek a Hive commander, but those are not so readily available. So I made you.

turns.user: And what am I to you?
turns.agent: There was a time I would have gladly laid in death beside you, here in these crypts. But we were both different then.
